notes.title: Nice Shot! Halloween Update out now!
notes.content:
Well, it only took 2 years, but here we are. Nice Shot! The Gun Golfing Game finally has new content!

And not just new content. This update hosts a whole slew of improvements to the game! We improved visual fidelity, performance, and loading times. We added some multiplayer features, and a new improvement to the range finder. Now when you rangefind with your gun, you can see the aim point on the minimap. [i]This makes some of the more precision golf much easier to do, and will be a great help on the low-visibility Desolate Dunes.[/i] Add on to that a half dozen bug and other miscellaneous fixes, and you've got yourself an update!

So, about the new course. Desolate Dunes is actually pretty welcoming during the day. But this is a Halloween update, so that won't do at all! Desolate Dunes is a very challenging, low-visibility course. Seeing ahead is hard, but your new rangefinder improvement, the minimap, and some smarts will get you far! As the name would imply, there is a lot of elevation change and a whole ton of sand. All of the little challenges add up to Desolate Dunes being an advanced-difficulty course. Make sure you're brushed up on your gun golf skills!

The full patch notes are below:

V1.1.0 patch notes:

[i]New Content
- Brand new course: Desolate Dunes

Improvements
- Graphical fidelity update. The game looks much better now.
- Faster load times.
- Improved performance.

New Features
- Added additional ammo (5 shots total) to each of the guns, with the exception of the special unlockable gun, which is now down to 1 shot. Consider this a gift from Tiger Woods to Dunkey.
- Your ball color is now visible to other players in multiplayer.
- You can now view the scorecard in-game in multiplayer.
- Added a rangefinder indicator. Now, when you are rangefinding with your gun, you can see the aim point on the minimap.

Bug/Misc Fixes:
- Fixed the bug where your ball could get stuck on top of a rock and be unreachable. The game will now consider it out of bounds and reset. (about time)
- Fixed a bug where your camera would be sticky at the minimum or maximum of your vertical look range.
- Fixed a bug that didn't always accurately get what terrain your ball is on.
- Modified wind behavior based on the course. More difficult courses will have a higher chance of difficult wind.
- Increased power of the Fairway Rifle.
- Made minor tweaks to gun powers to bring them more along the lines of expected behavior.[/i]

We hope you enjoy your new and improved gun golf, we sure enjoyed making it better.

Regards,
PolyGryph

notes.title: Nice Shot V 1.0.2 Patch
notes.content:
- On style mode in multiplayer, the scorecard will have a smaller text size to accommodate the larger numbers.

- In multiplayer, the text reading 9999y while other players are loading in is gone.

- The water collider on Palm Paradise hole 11 was a bit low. We adjusted it to its correct height.

- Preemptively fixed an integer underflow bug on multiplayer style mode, as well as put cheating prevention in place for multiplayer strokes mode.

- While in-game, the mouse is now contained to the window in windowed mode or while playing with multiple monitors.

- Fixed a bug introduced in the 1.0.1 patch where the scores wouldn't properly tick up on the end screen.

- Improved the UI experience for windowed players.

- Added a version number on the main menu.

Thanks again for your support!

notes.title: Nice Shot V 1.0.1 Patch
notes.content:
The 1.0.1 patch is half patch, half update. Here's what is different in 1.0.1:

-Multiplayer should now be cross-region! In the interest of transparency regarding this decision:

**This was accomplished by signing everyone on to one server, specifically U.S. East. This server was chosen based on sales data showing that choosing this region will negatively affect the least amount of buyers.

**If/when the game sells enough copies and has enough of an active player base to justify going back to regional mp with a cross-region opt-in we may do so to improve ping (more on that below), but we wanted to make it easier for our players to find multiplayer matches.

**Concerning the lower pings that will inevitably come with this decision, your ping doesn't actually matter that much for this game, as you can't interact with your opponents ball anyway. A lower ping just means it takes up to an extra quarter second for your hit to register on the other players screens. This will not affect the hole timer as that code is handled client side.


- In multiplayer games, you can now spectate the other player(s) after you have finished the hole.

- Fixed a major bug where your ball would easily get stuck on the rocks in Autumn Alcove. Also added some code to detect if your ball is stuck in the rocks, though this should now be an extreme corner case.

-You can now press space on the end hole point tally to instantly show your bonuses and point totals, rather that waiting for the animation to end.

-Minor typo fixes in the interface.

-Fixed lobby auto-refresh bug.

-Removed useless/unused key binding descriptions from launch options.

Thank you for buying Nice Shot! We hope this update improves your gun golfing experience!
